selection_rule: For each precommitted repository read at most newest32default-branch commits. No replacement for ineligible source. Use earliest two eligible observed source commits ordered by publisher commit time thenSHA. Source capture preserves exact APIJSON,Git commit/tree/parents and license metadata.
newness_scope: Publisher commit timestamp newer than prior corpus cut, not independent historical capture; verify Git object bytes separately.
task_assignment: Fixed repository position modulo4 before any source lookup. Adapt external immutable Git metadata to original controlled event schema; preserve original source exact bytes and explicit mapping. No invented external facts.
arm_semantics: Same original controlled event projection, first-hop, temporal revision, explicit correction and known program support. Target identifiers must be a registered reversible mapping of original Git tree/commit IDs. Procedure cases require actual read-only git cat-file process receipts.
freeze_and_scoring: Freeze complete source, questions, mapping, prompt/model/software hashes and calibration/test isolated projections before model execution. Freeze k from calibration only. Exact mapped identifier+source citation audit. No parameter training.
disqualifiers: publisher commit chronology not independently attested
